summary: Bug hunt: build, lint and all smoke tests pass, live site up. Fixed cut-off stat labels on the new All channels page and added that page to the smoke tests.
why: The All channels page (new on 11-18) wasn't covered by the smoke tests; its screenshot at desktop width showed 'Views 7d' cut to 'Vi…' and 'Stayed to watch' cut short.

findings.title: All channels: stat tile labels cut off
findings.detail: The change badge shared the label's row in the three-column cards, cutting 'Views 7d' to 'Vi…'.

findings.title: tsc needs a build first on a fresh clone
findings.detail: The channel logo PNG types come from the gitignored next-env.d.ts; logged in the backlog, harmless when the build runs first.

changes.title: All channels stat tiles show their whole label
changes.detail: Label gets the full width and may wrap, the change badge sits beside the number, subtitles may take two lines; /portfolio added to the smoke tests with a check that no label is cut off.
